summary:
Iteration 11 (pure refactor: empty-catch → console.warn, EventSource cleanup, CaseMap style constants + useCallback, ZoneRules activeZones useMemo, Login demo password prefill from REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS, backend refactors csv_ingest.rows_to_positions / gapfill.fill_gaps / detector.analyze / marine_regions.handle_import_eez) verified end-to-end. Behaviour unchanged from iter 10.

BACKEND (3/3 pytest pass in ~45s, test_iteration11_refactor.py):
(1) POST /api/ais/csv/preview → detected_mapping includes mmsi/timestamp/lat/lon aliases (MMSI, BaseDateTime, LAT, LON). row_count=5.
(2) POST /api/ais/csv/ingest → 201 with inserted=4, duplicates=0, row_errors=[{row:6, error:'empty MMSI'}], flagged=4, vessels=1, batch_id, mapping — row-level error correctly surfaced for empty-MMSI row using unique MMSI+timestamps to avoid dedup collisions.
(3) POST /api/cases/{SPL-001}/correlate with body {sync:true, params:{fill_gaps:true}} → 202 job status=succeeded; GET /candidates returns 12 candidates, envelope has gap_fill.version='gapfill-dr-0.1.0', and candidate.evidence.gap_segments present — gapfill.fill_gaps refactor preserves output shape.

FRONTEND (Playwright, public URL, wait_until='domcontentloaded'):
(a) Login /login: data-testid=demo-login-analyst click pre-fills BOTH email (analyst@sentinelmar.demo) AND password (len=12) from REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS='analyst:Analyst#2026,supervisor:Supervisor#2026'. Login page footer text shows 'Demo credentials are pre-filled.' (env var read correctly). Submit → dashboard with detector-precision-card.
(b) Case detail /cases/{SPL-001 id fetched via /api/cases}: case-map testid renders; 4 zone-kind toggles present; clicking zone-kind-eez off then on works (no console errors from CaseMap). 'Focus spill' click surfaces exactly 1 focus-vessel-label ('TOP CANDIDATE — not confirmed'). No console errors from map interactions.
(c) /zones as supervisor: zone-rules panel visible; rule-zone-select has 10 active zones; create with rule-name-input='TEST_iter11_rule_...' + rule-zone-select=first → rule appears in zone-rules-list; 'N active' counter goes '1 active'→'2 active'. Delete via zone-rule-delete-{id} → rule removed, counter returns. As analyst /zones renders zone-rules panel but zone-rule-form is correctly absent (RBAC).
(d) LiveFeed / SSE: With SPA-only router-link navigation (Dashboard→Jobs→Dashboard→Jobs→Dashboard, 4 hops), only 1 EventSource connection to /api/alerts/stream opened (initial mount) — no re-mounts, EventSource cleanup nullifies ref correctly. Live header indicator shows LIVE.
(e) Logout: data-testid=logout-button in header (icon-only, empty text) click → redirect to /login within timeout. AuthContext.logout swallows server failure gracefully with console.warn.

CONSOLE: 0 errors from refactored components. 1 pre-existing React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') persists — not introduced by this iteration; live selector option renders 'CODE · NAME' as text but somewhere a <span> is nested in an <option>. Pre-existing; noted for future cleanup.

issues: Warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — hydration warning traced to a select somewhere in the Layout tree (not from ZoneRules.jsx select which uses plain text). Cosmetic, no functional impact.
Recharts 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' still fires on mount — cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: LiveFeed.jsx effect cleanup now sets es=null after es.close() — prevents stale reference; failures counter and reconnect backoff (min(30s, 2s*failures)) intact. Good.
AuthContext.jsx logout: try/catch around POST /auth/logout with console.warn — even if server rejects, local token is cleared and user set to false. Correct fallback behavior.

CaseMap.jsx: All inline pathOptions/style objects (ASSET_STYLE, CORRIDOR_STYLE, DRIFT_*_STYLE, HIGHLIGHT_OPTS) hoisted to module constants; per-render helpers (spillStyle, trackOpts, headOpts, fixOpts, bpOpts) still allocate small objects but are trivially small and avoid closure over changing props. colorFor/selectHandler/zoneFilter useCallback-wrapped with correct dep arrays. This is a solid perf improvement — GeoJSON re-render key still includes zoneKinds join for correct toggling.
ZoneRules.jsx: activeZones useMemo prevents re-filtering zones prop on every render; activeRules count also memoized. Good.

Login.jsx DEMO_PASSWORDS Object.fromEntries at module scope parses 'analyst:Analyst#2026,supervisor:Supervisor#2026' correctly. Note: colon-splitting means passwords containing ':' would break — none of the current demo passwords contain ':', so safe. Consider splitting on first ':' only if password policy could ever include ':'.

csv_ingest.rows_to_positions: refactored to use _row_to_position helper + _f/_clean_mmsi/_str_or_none small utilities. Row-error contract preserved (row index starts at 2 for header offset, error string truncated to 160 chars). Empty MMSI raises 'empty MMSI' — surfaced to client as row_errors.

gapfill.fill_gaps: _dead_reckon helper cleanly separated; CARRY_KEYS constant makes fix propagation explicit. Segment record fields (spoof_suspect, interpolated_points, method) unchanged; GAP_FILL_VERSION constant unchanged so downstream cache keys stable.

detector.analyze: _dark_mask + _contour_to_spot decomposition improves testability. MIN_AREA_PX/MAX_AREA_FRAC/MIN_ELONGATION/MAX_SPOTS module constants — good. Confidence formula and pixel→geo affine untouched.

marine_regions.handle_import_eez: not directly re-tested (external WFS slow, per agent-to-agent note) but preserved from iter10 which verified zone_type territorial/contiguous/eez resolution end-to-end.
test_credentials: analyst analyst@sentinelmar.demo / Analyst#2026 and supervisor supervisor@sentinelmar.demo / Supervisor#2026 — both working via demo pre-fill.
seed_data_creation: TestCsvIngest inserts 4 AIS positions per run under a synthetic MMSI (900000000 + time%1e6), timestamps 3 days ago, vessel name TEST_ITER11_<hex> — small footprint, no cleanup endpoint. TestCorrelateGapFill triggers a new correlation_result version on SPL-20260610-001 (version increments each run — 42+ already). Supervisor zone-rule test creates 'TEST_iter11_rule_<epoch>' and deletes it in the same test — clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_refactor.py -v -o addopts='' --tb=short. Key gotchas: (1) POST /api/cases/{id}/correlate ALWAYS returns 202 status_code (declared in decorator) even when sync=true completes inline — check job['status']=='succeeded' + job['result'] instead of status code. (2) gap_fill_version lives at candidates_response['gap_fill']['version'] (envelope), NOT in job.result summary. (3) gap_segments lives at candidate['evidence']['gap_segments'], NOT at top-level candidate. (4) CSV ingest response uses row_errors (not errors) and returns 201 (not 200). Preview uses detected_mapping (not mapping). (5) Case list is /events not /cases — no /cases list route; fetch case id via /api/cases API then navigate to /cases/{id}. (6) Header logout has data-testid='logout-button' but no visible text (icon only). (7) SSE remounting only happens on full page reload, not SPA nav — use router-link clicks for the 'no duplicate EventSource' test.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — pure refactor iteration, no bugs surfaced. All refactored modules preserve exact behavior of iteration 10.
